changelog.title: 🎵 Redesigned Music Player
changelog.description: Revamped now-playing UI with fluid immersive transitions, seamless fullscreen-to-mini player switching, and gesture controls.

changelog.title: 📚 Redesigned Library & History
changelog.description: Brand-new Library layout, custom online playlist creator, and intelligent listening history tracking.

changelog.title: 🔍 Upgraded Search Engine
changelog.description: Strict multi-language and script matching ensuring accurate Hindi, Punjabi, and regional track results.

changelog.title: 💿 Redesigned Album Page
changelog.description: Modern album view with high-res cover art, full metadata, and quick track actions.

changelog.title: 🏠 Enhanced Home Screen
changelog.description: Improved content discovery logic with smart categorization and fast recommendation loading.

changelog.title: 🎚️ Hardware Equalizer & Sound
changelog.description: Master power toggle with disabled state greying and horizontally scrollable multi-band frequency sliders.

changelog.title: 🔀 Stable Fisher-Yates Shuffle
changelog.description: Upfront shuffle permutation with unique queue IDs ensuring every track plays once before any repeats.

changelog.title: 🛡️ Budget Phone Crash Protection
changelog.description: Completely isolated audio engine from video decoders, eliminating playback crashes on Unisoc, MediaTek, and Realme phones.

changelog.title: ⚡ Instant Audio Streaming
changelog.description: Restored immediate stream playback for tracks without separate audio streams (e.g. Summer High).

changelog.title: 🚫 Clean Queue Runway
changelog.description: Prevented accidental 50-track radio dumping on single track taps; playlists remain strictly bounded.

additionalNotes: To get the best from Obsidian, please keep your device up to date and regularly check for software updates.
